selection.name: Foundation 1
selection.rationale: The dependency closure of a real textured sprite game: create a native game, receive its lifecycle, expose its graphics device, clear, decode a PNG into a Texture2D, submit a SpriteBatch draw, read the keyboard, exit and destroy deterministically.

provenance.authority: hash-pinned public metadata of the Microsoft XNA Framework 4.0 Windows runtime profile
provenance.note: Public contract metadata only. No Microsoft binary is stored in this repository or distributed with it. Reproduce with tools/api-compat/import-contract.py and a snapshot of the pinned hash.

types.name: Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Graphics.GraphicsResource
types.reason: GraphicsResource's disposal contract, its Name, Tag and Disposing event need the event projection and the GraphicsDevice back-reference, neither of which is in Foundation 1. Texture2D and SpriteBatch carry CNA-Lisp's own disposal instead.

diagnostics.subject: Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Matrix.Decompose(Vector3&,Quaternion&,Vector3&)
diagnostics.detail: Decompose is implemented with unsafe pointer arithmetic over a private CanonicalBasis and VectorBasis pair -- some 540 IL instructions with a fallback path for degenerate scales. Reproducing it faithfully is a separate piece of work, and an approximation that agreed on well-conditioned matrices and diverged on degenerate ones would be worse than its absence.
